purpose: Outcome-free adequacy audit of a distinct RB1-proxy-to-SKP2 dependency direction
endpoint_access: ScreenNaiveGeneScore.csv header identity only; no SKP2 score row or target value parsed
eligibility_rule: PassesQC == True, CanInclude == True, Library in {Avana, KY}, exact ScreenID-to-ModelID map, nonblank eligible OncotreeLineage
status_rule: RB1 damaging proxy is 1 when RB1 (5925) matrix value is 1 or 2; reference is 0 when the matrix value is 0
selection_basis: Supplementary Table 3 of the primary Nature Genetics study lists SKP2 among RB1 synthetic-lethal genes reproduced in an isogenic screen. The frozen metadata audit tests whether the direction has enough damaging and matrix-intact models in both source families to justify execution.
rejection_reason: KY has only 18 RB1-damaging models, below the frozen minimum of 20; no endpoint values or planning design were computed, and no threshold was weakened.
literature_note: The Nature Genetics study reports RB1 synthetic-lethal genes from DepMap and an isogenic RB1 CRISPR screen; this audit does not claim SKP2 causality, druggability, treatment response, or clinical relevance.
